name: Workforce Knowledge Base Authoring and Promotion

h0.content: Knowledge-base authoring and promotion — supervisor review and merge lifecycle (ADR-0026 diagram 3 of 5, resolves Q2)

n1.content: receive_staging_item: Micro-ADR field record arrives from worker sync in D1 staging table (proposed tenant_micro_adrs / ScopedMicroAdrRepository; confirmed 0 live code hits via GitNexus) with status PENDING_REVIEW

n2.content: supervisor_load_queue: Supervisor opens review queue (proposed VerificationQueue UI) filtered by tenant_id and org_path subdivision prefix

n3.content: authenticate_mcp_supervisor: Supervisor capability checked via resolveMcpTenantAndSpec (cloudflare-worker/worker-mcp-drakon.js:2084) against harness_specs.agent_name and AGENT_ALLOWED_TOOLS (packages/harness-contract/src/index.ts:107)

n4.content: render_submission_details: UI presents raw field note (context / action / result) alongside attached evidence photos and telemetry readings

n5.content: invoke AI-agent summarization and standard ADR formatting?

n6.content: ai_summarize_adr: AI supervisor agent drafts structured ADR representation (title, status, context, decision, consequences matching src/lib/adr/parser.ts:parseAdr / parseFrontmatter convention); output is strictly advisory draft for human reviewer

n7.content: human_supervisor_evaluates: Supervisor reviews technical validity, safety compliance, and operational applicability of the proposed solution

n8.content: supervisor approves record for organizational promotion?

n9.content: approve_and_promote: Supervisor confirms approval -> status changes PENDING_REVIEW -> PROMOTED; record merges into shared org_path knowledge base repository (accessible to all workers in subtree for future task guidance)

n10.content: return submission for worker rework or reject outright?

n11.content: return_for_rework: Supervisor adds mandatory feedback comments -> status updated to CHANGES_REQUESTED -> queued in D1 to sync back to authoring worker device

n12.content: reject_record: Supervisor sets status to REJECTED with logged rationale -> record archived in D1 staging, excluded from organizational KB

n13.content: audit_log_review_action: Review transaction recorded via McpToolAuditRepository.record (packages/tenancy/src/repositories.ts:329) with supervisor identity, decision timestamp, and target item_id

end.content: Knowledge promotion lifecycle complete. PROMOTED records are immediately active and retrievable by role-scoped workers across the org_path hierarchy.

meta.description: Diagram 3 of ADR-0026 detailing list ('knowledge base authoring/promotion'). Details the exact lifecycle and data flow from worker Micro-ADR submission through D1 staging, optional AI-assisted formatting, deterministic manual supervisor review, and final promotion into the shared organizational knowledge base.
meta.promotion_mechanism: Manual supervisor review step with optional AI-agent-assisted ADR summarization draft. Deterministic human sign-off; no confidence-score auto-promotion, adhering to ADR-0026 Q2 and Plan §3.3/§3.5.

confirmed_against_code.proposed_unimplemented_symbols: tenant_micro_adrs, ScopedMicroAdrRepository, tenant_work_items, ScopedWorkItemRepository, VerificationQueue, MicroAdrDialog — GitNexus query/context confirmed 0 live code symbols (proposed in 002-workforce-tables.sql and Slice 5.1 plan)

offline_sync_conflict.note: Re-submission after rework uses updated_at version witnesses in D1 staging table to prevent concurrent modification races between supervisor review and offline worker resubmission.

device_loss_theft.note: Promoted knowledge base records are distributed back to worker devices scoped strictly by org_path subtrees, maintaining tenant data-minimization.

multilingual_runtime.note: Worker field notes captured in local language (e.g. Ukrainian) can be translated or normalized into standard ADR format during the AI summarization step (n6) prior to supervisor review.

native_hardware_battery.note: Supervisor review UI is a responsive desktop/tablet dashboard operating over standard HTTPS/MCP queries, not requiring persistent mobile connections.

not_covered_by_this_diagram: Cross-tenant knowledge federations (strictly isolated per tenant_id per ADR-0025)
Automated semantic clustering of duplicate Micro-ADRs across multiple brigades (future enhancement)
